timeline.text: Every night, a robot voice reads the day's tech news out loud, in Norwegian.
That voice came from a paid service, and when its balance ran dry, every video broke at that step.
Nobody could tell if the voice failed, or the bill was just unpaid.
The fix switches to Edge TTS, a free voice engine, cutting the middleman out.
It also times every word for the subtitles, instead of guessing from silence. The digest is unblocked after four days.
